# standard-cluster

A cluster with CRDs, an issuer, trust, in-cluster DNS, a gateway and a secret generator.

<!-- Generated by nix/floe-docs.nix. Refresh: nix run .#refresh-floe-docs -->

A **preset**: a floe that includes floes. It is expanded into the
members below where it is placed, so they link exactly as if the lab
had written them itself.

## Inputs

| input | type | default | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| omit | list of string | `[]` | Members to leave out, by name. Naming one the preset does not have is refused: a typo that silently omits nothing is how a preset becomes something people fork instead of parameterise.  |
| overrides | attribute set of raw value | `{}` | Members to replace, keyed by the member's name. A replacement must provide what it replaces, which is checked — swapping a gateway for something that is not one is refused here rather than at whichever consumer resolved against it first.  |
| provisioner | raw value | *(required)* | The floe that brings the cluster into existence — any floe providing `KUBERNETES_CLUSTER`. No default: which kind of cluster this is, is the one thing a preset must not decide for you.  |
| rootFromLab | boolean | `false` | Sign from the lab's CA rather than a root minted in this cluster. What lets one ingress terminate for several clusters with one certificate.  |
| tls | boolean | `true` | Whether the gateway terminates TLS. |

## Provides

| provision | signature | what it is |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cluster | KUBERNETES_CLUSTER | The cluster a member installs into: its name, version, context and address ranges. |
| gateway | API_GATEWAY | An ingress a workload attaches an HTTPRoute to, and the zone its hostnames live in. |
| gatewayApi | GATEWAY_API | The Gateway API CRDs are registered, so Gateway and route kinds have types. |
| generation | SECRET_GENERATION | A controller that mints secret values in the cluster, so none is rendered into a manifest. |
| issuance | X509_ISSUANCE | Something that signs certificates, and whether a browser will trust what it signs. |
| trust | TRUST_BUNDLE | A CA bundle distributed into namespaces, for workloads that verify the lab's own certificates. |
